page.overview:
Who is Dream-Eater?

Dream-Eater is one of the Autobot-allied Beastformers fighting a war on the planet Beest. His role in the Autobot Beastformer forces is "Special Combat Unit". He also holds the rank of Emperor of Erku, the country on whose plains he was born, under King White Cow.
